bullets.title: The Last of the Mohicans movie soundtrack
bullets.note:
This was introduced to me by Alex Honnold, the world’s most famous free-solo
climber, during [our podcast
together](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=wkB&mc=e&s=bomwH&u=w&y=6&).
If this soundtrack is good enough for some of his death-defying records, it’s
certainly good enough for fueling writing sessions or nearly anything
requiring an injection of inspiration.

bullets.title: The History of Japan in 9 Minutes
bullets.note:
This clever (and funny) video was introduced to me by [Kevin
Kelly](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=wkN&mc=e&s=bomwH&u=w&y=v&)
after a catch-up session at my house. It’s a little slow for the first few
minutes, but it covers--to use their language--a “fuck ton.” How? In part, by
omitting reading the proper nouns and intelligently using text overlay.
Definitely worth the time.
